svg.data-psu-redundancy: 1+1, two hot-swappable AC or DC supplies (rear)
svg.data-services: E-LINE, E-LAN, E-TREE; MPLS L2VPN, L3VPN, H-VPLS; SR; IPv4/v6 routing
svg.data-uni-mix: 48 UNI cages of which 16 are SFP+ (10G/1G) and 32 SFP (1G/100M) - which ones is undocumented
svg.data-local: CONSOLE on USB, SNMP out-of-band Ethernet on RJ45
